title: Sensor reading
description: Value of the records on factorymind.telemetry.readings. Producer: telemetry-service (simulator and POST /api/telemetry/readings). Consumers: telemetry-service, ai-insights-service. Record key: assetId. New optional fields may be added; removing or renaming a field, or adding an enum value, needs the consumers first (see contracts/README.md).

readingId.description: Unique id of the reading (consumers ignore a reading id they already stored)

assetId.description: Machine (also the record key, so the readings of one machine stay in order)

value.description: Measured value, in the unit of the sensor definition
